# Vetta 0.6.20
<!-- release-status: unreleased -->

## English

### New

- Settings → Vetta Vivi adds size, auto-switching, action previews and interaction tips. Auto-switch and always-on-top changes made from Vivi's right-click menu are now saved and shown in Settings.

### Improvements

- Chat stays responsive while the agent writes large files, while long conversations stream, and while a running subagent or workflow is open in the side panel.
- Team conversations stay smooth while members reply, even with a long history.
- Large files no longer freeze the preview: code, JSON and logs over 100 KB open in a lightweight viewer with line numbers, and big Markdown renders in sections. Markdown and HTML over 200 KB open on the source first.
- Settings pages such as Appearance open without a blank pause the first time.

### Upgrade notes

- Vivi's holiday speech-bubble styles have been removed. If you picked one, Vivi goes back to the default bubble that follows the app theme.

## 中文

### 新增

- 设置 → Vetta Vivi 新增大小、自动切换、动作预览与互动说明；在 Vivi 右键菜单切换自动切换和置顶后会保存，设置页同步显示。

### 改进

- Agent 写入大文件、长会话流式输出，以及在侧边面板查看运行中的子代理或 workflow 时，界面不再卡顿。
- 团队会话在成员回复时更流畅，历史很长时也一样。
- 大文件预览不再卡住：超过 100KB 的代码、JSON、日志改用带行号的轻量查看器，大 Markdown 分段渲染；超过 200KB 的 Markdown、HTML 先显示源码。
- 首次打开外观等设置页不再空白片刻。

### 升级注意

- Vivi 的节日气泡样式已移除，之前选过的会回到跟随应用主题的默认气泡。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.19...v0.6.20
